When will the MarsBot pick up the cargo?
Take a look at this script and choose under what condition the MarsBot will pick up the cargo.
ANSWER
When it is run
If the cargo under the MarsBot is in the shape of a prism
When it turns to the left
If the cargo under the MarsBot is in the shape of a cube
